I · OCVLVS — THE EYE

To see, is to exist.

The Romans left one eye eternally open in the dome of the Pantheon, making light the temple's only god. Two thousand years later we cast that eye into a shape you can wear — not a screen, but a door into another Rome.

II · RENDERE — NEURAL RENDERING

Every frame, a fresco.

Foveated rendering lets compute behave like candlelight — it illuminates only where you gaze. Wherever the pupil turns, the marble is carved to meet it. One hundred and twenty times a second, and not one frame profaned.

III · SENSVS — TOUCH & SOUND

Let the wind pass through your shield.

Beneath the imperial-red cushion sleep sixty-four pressure cells: the shock of sword on shield climbs from your temples down your spine. The spatial soundscape lets a whisper arrive from any bench of the Colosseum — every direction you hear is a real direction.

VII · INVERSIO — THE INVERSION

You are inside the picture now.

The gallery you left behind drifts past like a framed relic — proof that worlds can be worn both ways. Drag it, if you doubt it is real. Around you, the hours themselves orbit the arena in gilded numerals, and the great eye above blinks — slowly — as if memorising your face.
